question: Who of the following is famous for playing musical instrument Kanjira?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pudukkotai Dakshinamurthi Pillai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pudukkotai Dakshinamurthi Pillai** is renowned for his exceptional skills in playing the **Kanjira**.
 
• The Kanjira is a South Indian frame drum and is an essential component of Carnatic music
